_comment: Copy to calibration.local.json and fill in with YOUR device calibration. Those numbers are the output of a calibration campaign against measured hysteresis; this project does not ship anyone's.
_comment2: eps_fe_bg is the ferroelectric's BACKGROUND relative permittivity, the value your .par carries for the film. It moved out of the .par because the fixed-slab thickness remap has to scale it with t_fe; see t1_driver.deck_values.
_comment3: l_gate_slab_nm / t_il_slab_nm / n_ch_slab are the geometry YOUR grid was actually built at. They are only used when T1_REBUILD_MESH=1, as the control case: build a mesh at these numbers and the nominal design point must land on the same figures of merit the fixed-slab path gives. See t1/sde_fefet_mesh.cmd.
